name: Maria Júlia
source:
Maria Júlia, mostly known as just Júlia, is the second oldest out of the seven children of Nhô Chico and Maria.
She's 28 years old, happily married with two small daughters.
She's more reserved and quite prude.

[From [url=https://gongonstudio.itch.io/a-kiss-from-death]itch.io[/url]]
